text: Across all paired N=128/N=256 seeds on data_seeds 0 and 1, read from probes_final, is the per-seed change in trained force R2 centred on zero with a spread of about +/-0.04, while the force control rise is consistently >= 0.05? If so, is the N=128-to-N=256 force decline a control effect plus model-seed noise rather than a dataset-specific split?
